summary: Phoenix proposal batch fails promotion gate due to insufficient fixed-24m OOS evidence and unresolved data provenance issues. All proposals remain research-only pending committee recheck.
top_technical_reasons: Fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss metrics do not beat empirical baseline at required anchors (6/12/18/24 months) for any proposal.
Realized-note sample and dealer quote provenance remain incomplete, violating data contract integrity.
Persistent MetaAgent state introduces test state-dependence, risking non-deterministic outcomes.
Human compliance/model-risk review is required before any implementation.
No proposal demonstrates measurable improvement in production behavior or stability.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Adding source reliability scores per field (phoenix-201) will improve fixed-24m OOS calibration without altering production behavior.
next_experiments.change: Implement source reliability scoring with fallback to empirical baseline if metrics degrade.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss must beat empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Validates whether reliability scoring enhances evidence quality without destabilizing production.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Validating timezone normalization at ingestion (phoenix-202) will reduce duplicate observations and improve data consistency.
next_experiments.change: Add timezone normalization validation with rollback to raw timestamps if anomalies exceed threshold.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss must beat empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Tests whether normalization reduces noise in time-series data without introducing bias.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Detecting duplicate observations across providers (phoenix-203) will improve data integrity without altering model inputs.
next_experiments.change: Implement deduplication logic with manual review fallback for ambiguous cases.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss must beat empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Assesses whether deduplication reduces overfitting or spurious correlations.

data_or_label_risks: Incomplete provenance for realized notes and dealer quotes may introduce undetected biases.
Corporate-action adjustment provenance (phoenix-204) is unvalidated, risking incorrect backtesting.
MetaAgent state persistence could lead to non-reproducible test results.
No proposal addresses the root cause of insufficient fixed-24m OOS evidence.
